executive_summary.text: Q3 2026 shows mixed performance: Instagram reach and interactions fell sharply versus Q2 2026 but surged year‑on‑year; Facebook views rose sharply YoY while link clicks fell to zero; LinkedIn metrics improved QoQ except engagement rate; publications halved QoQ; email and media activity were newly recorded. Data gaps limit deeper insight.

key_findings.statement: Instagram reach added up to 26,069, a 1.7% decline from Q2 2026 but a 271.2% increase YoY.
Facebook link clicks were zero in Q3 2026, a 100% drop from Q3 2025 and unchanged from Q2 2026 (no prior clicks).
LinkedIn total impressions grew 19% QoQ to 67,085, while engagement rate fell 9.7% points to 9.5%.
Verified publications fell 54.2% QoQ to 11 and 38.9% YoY to 18.

kpi_analysis.interpretation: Only one KPI was recorded this quarter, matching Q2 2026 but 97.5% fewer than Q3 2025, indicating a sharp drop in KPI reporting activity.
No new external collaborations were recorded, unchanged from Q2 2026 and a 100% drop from Q3 2025, suggesting limited partnership activity.
Conference entries fell 62.5% QoQ to six, reflecting reduced conference participation.
Poster presentations declined 44.4% QoQ to ten.
Eleven email campaigns were sent, a new activity compared with zero in prior periods.
Nine media entries were recorded, a new activity compared with zero in prior periods.

website.summary: Website data not connected; no analysis possible.

social.summary: Instagram metrics declined QoQ but rose YoY; Facebook views up YoY, clicks down to zero; LinkedIn impressions up, engagement rate down.

findings.statement: Instagram interactions fell 48.6% QoQ to 635, yet were 684% higher YoY.
LinkedIn new followers grew 32% QoQ to 445.

email.summary: Eleven campaigns delivered 1,174 emails with 45.7% open rate and 11.7% engagement rate.

findings.statement: Email open rate was 45.7% and click‑to‑open rate 25.6%.

media.summary: Nine media entries generated a total of 27 mentions this quarter.

findings.statement: Media rows count was 9, up from zero in prior periods.

publications.summary: Publications dropped to 11, with 63.6% open access.

events.summary: One Eventbrite event with capacity 1,100 was held; no prior events for comparison.

findings.statement: Event capacity was 1,100 for the single event.

conferences.summary: Conference participation declined across entries, posters, and oral presentations.

findings.statement: Conference entries fell 62.5% QoQ to six.

kpis.summary: KPI reporting limited to one recorded KPI; external collaborations at zero.

findings.statement: Only one KPI was recorded, a 97.5% drop YoY.

trends.statement: Instagram reach and interactions show strong YoY growth but QoQ decline, indicating seasonal fluctuation or campaign timing effects.

cross_dataset.statement: Email open rates (45.7%) are higher than social link‑click rates (e.g., Instagram clicks 62), suggesting email may be a more effective direct channel.

risks.statement: Zero Facebook link clicks this quarter may reflect reduced audience engagement or measurement inconsistencies.
Sharp QoQ declines in Instagram reach and interactions could signal waning audience interest if not addressed.

opportunities.statement: LinkedIn impressions grew 19% QoQ, offering a platform to amplify content and drive higher engagement.
Email campaigns achieved a 45.7% open rate and 11.7% engagement rate, indicating potential to expand audience outreach via email.

recommendations.recommendation: Review Instagram content strategy and posting cadence to address the 1.7% QoQ decline in reach and 48.6% drop in interactions.
recommendations.reasoning: QoQ declines suggest reduced effectiveness; improving content relevance may restore growth.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Stabilise or increase Instagram audience engagement.

recommendations.recommendation: Leverage the rising LinkedIn impressions by increasing post frequency and promoting high‑engagement content to improve the falling engagement rate.
recommendations.reasoning: Impressions are up but engagement rate down; more targeted posts could boost interactions.

recommendations.recommendation: Expand email campaign volume while maintaining current open and engagement rates to broaden reach and support research dissemination.
recommendations.reasoning: Email shows strong performance; scaling can amplify impact without sacrificing quality.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Increased stakeholder communication and potential citation impact.

limitations: All figures were calculated by the dashboard from the sources above. The AI interpreted them but did not calculate any number, and every figure it quotes was checked against the data; any problems found are shown with the report.
Where a period was not fully covered by data, comparisons use the same number of days in each period.
Instagram reach adds up each day's reach, so one account can be counted on several days; it is not the number of unique accounts reached.
Facebook clicks from the live Meta connection are "page actions" (clicks on the Page's buttons); older days come from exported link clicks, which are a different measure.
Follower figures are new followers gained, not net growth: people who unfollowed are not subtracted.
Changes between periods show association, not cause.
